Data:Present.h.edge.alte..json.label: Call for my History to be witnessed
Data:Present.h.edge.alte..json.startdescription: 'Earth, sky, sea: bear witness to my work. [You've wrought a History which at least one of the Hours will endorse. This is the point of no return. Many of these Histories are strange or wild. Unless you're certain you want to end the game, remain here in the peace of the House.]
